loginKey, kdfSalt, kdfIterations match types.go RuntimeAuthRequest; kdf_salt and kdf_iterations match PreLoginResponse.

Two implementations of the derivation (frontend loginKeys.ts, omnirave loginKey.ts): both match shared/crypto-vectors/login-keys.json, computed by Node crypto, so they cannot drift unseen.
